title: Security questionnaire back next Friday
transcript:
[00:00] Rosa: Thanks for jumping on. Brightwater Logistics sent over their security questionnaire, and it's the long one. About two hundred questions.
[00:12] Kwame: I saw it. A lot of it maps to our SOC 2 answers, so maybe half is copy and paste.
[00:21] Lena: The other half is the data residency section. They want to know where backups live.
[00:30] Kwame: Backups stay in the EU region for EU customers. I need to check whether Brightwater is set up as EU or US.
[00:42] Rosa: They're headquartered in the US, but the pilot team sits in Rotterdam.
[00:49] Kwame: Then I'll answer for both and flag it.
[00:54] Lena: Do we attach the pen test summary or just reference it?
[01:00] Kwame: Attach the summary letter. Not the full report, that needs an NDA.
[01:08] Lena: We have a mutual NDA with them already. I'll double check it covers security documents.
[01:17] Rosa: OK, timing. Their procurement lead said they need it back next Friday.
[01:25] Kwame: Next Friday is fine. I can block out time for it.
[01:31] Rosa: Great, so Kwame owns the questionnaire, back to them next Friday.
[01:38] Lena: And I'll do the legal and insurance sections, those are mine anyway. I'll pass them to Kwame to merge in.
[01:49] Kwame: Works. Put them in the shared folder, not email.
[01:55] Rosa: I'll let their procurement lead know it's in progress.
[02:01] Lena: Do they want it in their portal or as a spreadsheet?
[02:06] Rosa: Spreadsheet. They said the portal is being replaced.
[02:12] Kwame: Good. The portal versions always break our formatting.
[02:19] Lena: One question on insurance. Do they want the certificate itself or just the coverage amounts?
[02:28] Rosa: I'll ask when I write to procurement.
[02:33] Lena: Thanks.
[02:35] Rosa: That's it from me. Thanks, both.
